CORA

Apr–May 2026

Multiplayer game backend

I built CORA’s server-side match loop and settlement verification, keeping game state, deposits, and payouts aligned across concurrent events.

Team 9th of 482 · Frontier Hackathon, 100xDevs Track

Real-time systems
Live demo Source code

Problem

Keep concurrent multiplayer matches and native SOL wagers consistent from deposit through payout.

My role

Backend developer for the match state machine, settlement oracle, and Solana Actions endpoints.

Approach

Connected Bun and Hono WebSockets to a verification, signature, and payout flow. Added wSOL wrapping and a sequential deposit state machine.

Key decision

Locked transaction parameters at each step so racing match events could not produce different payouts.

On-chain integration

Integrated MagicBlock Ephemeral to mirror gameplay on-chain for verification.

Result

Delivered a real-time match loop with deterministic settlement. Team CORA placed 9th among 482 submissions in the 100xDevs Frontier Hackathon Track.
